evidence: bridge/table.rs:513-525 checks only slot existence then replaces erased provider; bridge/table.rs:118-135 downcasts Arc<T> and maps mismatch to NotEnabled; extension_registry/register/bridge_registration.rs:19-43 keys exports by T::INTERFACE_ID; public reload_provider accepts any T for any valid slot.
impact_or_question: A caller can replace one interface slot with a provider of another trait while the entry still reports Enabled; all typed calls on the original slot fail as NotEnabled.
next_action: Validate slot interface_id against T::INTERFACE_ID before mutation, add wrong-slot regression and check public hot-reload callers.
